localContext: Elmhurst garages face unique challenges that damage tracks. The city's older housing stock, especially Brick Georgians and Tudors from the 1930s-50s in areas like College View and Crescent Park, often have original detached garages. These structures can shift over decades due to ground settlement and freeze-thaw cycles common in Chicagoland winters. This shifting can misalign track sections. Newer, oversized attached garages on rebuilt lots in Elmhurst City Centre are also susceptible. Heavy daily use, combined with structural stress from large door openings, can cause tracks to bend or separate from the jamb. A door that won't seal properly at the slab is a concern for Elmhurst owners. The Salt Creek flooding history makes a weather-tight door a critical part of home defense. We understand this local need for precise track alignment and a secure door seal.
